To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Chinese elderly immigrants have different oral health related beliefs and behaviours from their counterparts in China and that these are influenced by the cultural, social, and political factors of immigration and acculturation, as well as by structural factors mediating their access to Western oral health care.
The oral health of Chinese immigrants is influenced by a complex interplay of traditional and Western beliefs and by a variety of structural factors that mediate access to dental care.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding and promoting oral health for elderly Chinese immigrants in North America.
the oral health of elderly Chinese immigrants, and with the role of culture in the development of oral health related beliefs and behaviours.
the oral health of a growing population of elderly Chinese immigrants, a group whose health status has received little attention in the literature.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the cultural beliefs of elderly Chinese immigrants are influenced by their oral health-related behaviours and that these beliefs and behaviours in turn are influenced by the structural factors of immigration and the access of the Chinese to Western dental care.
the oral health related beliefs and behaviours of elderly Chinese immigrants are influenced by culture.
Chinese elderly immigrants have a unique cultural background and experience of immigration, which has a significant influence on their beliefs and behaviours regarding oral health.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a need to develop a better understanding of cultural influences on the health beliefs and behaviours of elderly Chinese immigrants.
culture has a significant impact on the beliefs, attitudes, and behaviors related to oral health in Chinese immigrants.

there are several cultural beliefs and practices that may influence the oral health related beliefs and behaviours of Chinese immigrants, and that these beliefs and behaviours can have an impact on the oral health of Chinese immigrants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the health of elderly Chinese immigrants is a complex issue that cannot be reduced to a simple set of cultural beliefs.
oral health in old age is not just a matter of dental disease and treatment.
cultural and structural barriers to care are not immutable, but rather are malleable and can be addressed by the dental profession.
